description: Figure 12 displays Pass@8 accuracy on the merged AIME 2024 and AMC datasets, plotted against varying generation temperatures ranging from 0.1 to 1.0 on the x-axis. The y-axis represents Accuracy (Pass@8), scaled linearly from 62.5 to 80.0. Three distinct lines represent different models: On-policy RL (orange line with star markers), LUFFY (red line with star markers), and SFT (teal line with triangle markers). Across the temperature range, both RL-based methods—On-policy RL and LUFFY—show strong exploratory capabilities, with their accuracy improving as temperature increases, peaking around 0.7–0.8 for LUFFY and 0.6–0.7 for On-policy RL before slightly declining. In contrast, SFT demonstrates fragility, starting at approximately 75.0 accuracy at temperature 0.1, dropping to around 67.5 at temperature 0.3, and then fluctuating with a general downward trend, reaching its lowest point near 65.0 at temperature 1.0.
